name: Determinar cuando un cliente puede alquilar un auto (Caso 3)
untr_name: Determining When a Customer Could Rent a Car (Case 3)
description: Construya un programa que determine si un cliente puede alquilar un auto en base a las entradas que recibe del agente de alquiler. Los autos de alquiler estan disponibles para conductores con licencia que tengan al menos 21 anos o que tengan una tarjeta de credito con 10000 USD o mas de credito.
untr_description: Construct a program that determines whether a customer could rent a car based on the inputs that it receives from the car rental agent. Rental cars are available to licensed drivers who are either at least 21 years old or have a credit card with $10,000 or more of credit.

comments.content: La expresion 'hasLicense && (age >= 21 || credit >= 10000)' usa operadores logicos para evaluar las condiciones. El operador '&&' asegura que el cliente debe tener licencia de conducir. El operador '||' permite dos posibilidades: el cliente tiene al menos 21 anos, o tiene un monto de credito de 10000 USD o mas.
comments.untr_content: The expression 'hasLicense && (age >= 21 || credit >= 10000)' uses logical operators to evaluate the conditions. The '&&' operator ensures that the customer must have a driver's license. The '||' operator allows for two possibilities: the customer is at least 21 years old, or they have a credit amount of $10,000 or more.

comments.content: Una idea equivocada comun podria ser no entender la precedencia de los operadores logicos. El operador '&&' tiene mayor precedencia que '||', pero aqui se usan parentesis para agrupar explicitamente las condiciones de edad y credito, asegurando que se evaluen juntas.
comments.untr_content: A common misconception might be misunderstanding the precedence of logical operators. The '&&' operator has higher precedence than '||', but parentheses are used here to explicitly group the age and credit conditions, ensuring they are evaluated together.

distractors.description: Podria elegir este distractor si confunde los operadores logicos '&&' (y) y '||' (o). Esta linea usa incorrectamente '||' entre 'hasLicense' y la condicion de edad/credito, lo que sugiere que tener licencia O cumplir ambas condiciones de edad y credito es suficiente. Esto permitira que alguien sin licencia alquile un auto si cumple tanto la condicion de edad como la de credito, lo cual no es la logica deseada. El programa permitiria incorrectamente alquileres a personas sin licencia, provocando un comportamiento no intencionado. Es crucial entender la diferencia entre 'y' y 'o' para asegurar que las condiciones se combinen correctamente.
distractors.untr_description: You might choose this distractor if you confuse the logical operators '&&' (and) and '||' (or). This line incorrectly uses '||' between 'hasLicense' and the age/credit condition, suggesting that having a license OR meeting both age and credit conditions is sufficient. This would allow someone without a license to rent a car if they meet both age and credit conditions, which is not the intended logic. The program would incorrectly allow rentals to unlicensed individuals, leading to unintended behavior. It's crucial to understand the difference between 'and' and 'or' to ensure the conditions are combined correctly.

distractors.description: Este distractor puede parecer correcto si no entiende como los parentesis afectan la evaluacion de las expresiones logicas. Aqui, los parentesis agrupan 'hasLicense && age >= 21', sugiriendo que tener licencia y ser al menos 21 es una condicion, O tener credito suficiente es otra. Esto permitiria que alguien con suficiente credito alquile un auto sin licencia, lo cual es incorrecto. El programa permitira incorrectamente alquileres a individuos que solo cumplen la condicion de credito, violando el requisito de tener licencia. Entender como los parentesis cambian el agrupamiento y el orden de evaluacion de las condiciones es esencial para evitar tales errores.
distractors.untr_description: This distractor might seem correct if you misunderstand how parentheses affect the evaluation of logical expressions. Here, the parentheses group 'hasLicense && age >= 21', suggesting that having a license and being at least 21 is one condition, OR having sufficient credit is another. This would allow someone with enough credit to rent a car without a license, which is incorrect. The program would incorrectly permit rentals to individuals who only meet the credit condition, violating the requirement for a license. Understanding how parentheses change the grouping and evaluation order of conditions is essential to avoid such errors.

distractors.description: Podria seleccionar este distractor si por error piensa que todas las condiciones deben cumplirse para un alquiler. Esta linea requiere que el cliente tenga licencia, sea al menos 21, y tenga 10000 USD de credito, lo cual es demasiado restrictivo. Impediria que alquilen personas que estan autorizadas y que cumplen cualquiera de las condiciones de edad o credito, contrario a la logica pretendida. El programa negaria alquileres a clientes elegibles, llevando a un comportamiento excesivamente estricto. Es importante reconocer cuando las condiciones deben combinarse con 'o' para permitir multiples escenarios validos.
distractors.untr_description: You might select this distractor if you mistakenly believe that all conditions must be met for a car rental. This line requires the customer to have a license, be at least 21, and have $10,000 credit, which is overly restrictive. It would prevent rentals to individuals who are licensed and either meet the age or credit condition, contrary to the intended logic. The program would deny rentals to eligible customers, leading to overly strict behavior. It's important to recognize when conditions should be combined with 'or' to allow for multiple valid scenarios.
